evidence.detail: guess_banner() iterates season_playability descending and picks top card per color group — purely most-played, no uniqueness comparison
season_playability() SELECT name, playability FROM _season_playability WHERE season_id = N ORDER BY playability DESC LIMIT 100 — no cross-season comparison
bakert's comments contain a working SQL query using score_above_average = this_season.playability - AVG(prev seasons) to identify cards most unique to that season
